notes.title: Yuu's Route Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

This is a very quick update to let you know that Yuu's route should be live. You should be able to update your game and access his route now.

The game walkthrough and content guide list have been updated as well as so if you have been using those, you should be able to visit the existing links and see Yuu's content available.

There are quite a few new achievements available - including the standard two for Yuu's route (and an additional one in his route), plus an additional one in the common route, Caleb's route, Reuben's Route, Jack's Route, and Caissa's route.

If you have any major issues or glitches, please let me know. As usual, I am not planning to push build updates for minor typos. We tried to catch as many as we could.

Thank you everyone!

notes.title: Reuben's Route
notes.notes:
Reuben's route has been released to Steam.

Old saves should still work however, please understand it can be difficult to predict how even small additions and deletions of content can affect saves. You load an old save that leads to an error, please try to load the game from scratch to see if the error repeats before you report it.

If it does not repeat, the error was with that specific save.

Reuben's route has two achievements like all other routes.

As a quick update to Quill's route, the draft is around 46%. I hope to have his route completed by Q3 of this year!

Hope you enjoy the new content!
~Esh

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Quill's route has been released. 

There is nothing in particular you need to do to get to his route. It unlocks naturally with a specific choice in the common route (choose to hide instead of run when giving the option during the sequence where the MC is in the abandoned district.)

While it shouldn't be required, please consider starting a new game to begin his route. 

There shouldn't be any save compatibility issues, however, there were minor changes to some of the other routes (primarily typo fixes or minor wording changes for continuity) as well. If you do run into a game-breaking error after loading an old save, [b]please start a new game and see if the error still occurs before you report it.[/b]

Reuben's route is the next route I am working to complete. It is currently about 60% drafted and my focus for the next month or two will be getting it drafted and fully edited.

~Esh
